targetPopulation: Public https sites drawn from the frozen frame: a finance- and news-weighted pool where prior corpus evidence indicates first-party subdomain CNAME delegation is plausible, balanced with reference and open-source sites, each having served two successful unauthenticated automated desktop visits during the preregistered reliability sweep. Rates describe this frame population only. The reference-present denominator confirms only at scan time; the study accepts the risk that the floor is not reached, in which case no rate publishes.

design.selectionProtocol: Frame of exactly 400 sites drawn by seeded simple random sampling from the reliability-screened candidate pool defined in docs/calibration-prereg-drafts/frame-construction.md: a fixed pool of 600+ candidates composed half from the detector's likely-positive strata defined in frame-construction.md and half from likely-clean strata (reference, government, open source), every candidate having passed two pre-freeze automated visits under the exact measurement condition. The random seed is the SHA-256 of this study's committed preregistration.json, computed after commit and recorded in the frame tooling output, so the draw is deterministic, reproducible, and fixed before any acquisition.
design.referenceProtocol: Each labeler independently reviews the blinded per-case evidence bundle, including recorded DNS chains, and asserts present when a first-party subdomain resolves through a CNAME chain to a documented tracking vendor per the protocol's vendor list, and absent otherwise.
design.adjudicationProtocol: Two through ten distinct GitHub actors label every case independently and blind to each other. One additional distinct actor precommits a blind tiebreaker source before acquisition. Agreements stand as final. Any disagreement is resolved by the precommitted tiebreaker alone, recorded as disagreement-resolved-by-blind-tiebreaker with the tiebreaker identity and artifact digest; no post-hoc discussion, relabeling, or majority vote occurs.

measurementCondition.interpretation: Rates are conditional on desktop visits with GPC disabled under passive consent observation with no consent action.
